title: How the guards in my stealth game decide if they’ve seen you (light + noise)
author: Any_Inevitable_4035
selftext:
Hey all,

Following up on my first game, Shizu no Kage. A few people asked how the stealth works, so here’s the breakdown.

Guards use two senses:

* **Light.** Every lamp throws a cone of light. If Akari steps into one, guards with a line of sight can spot her. Stay in the dark between lamps and you’re invisible.
* **Sound.** Sneaking is silent, but walking, sprinting, and landing from a jump each send out a noise ring with a different range. A guard inside the ring turns and walks over to check.

Guards don’t instantly alert. There’s a suspicion meter, so a quick glimpse makes them curious and staying exposed gets you caught. Lookouts on rooftops sweep the street from above.

You can also play with the lamps: snuff one out to open a path, or relight it to pull a guard away from where you want to go.

The part I’m least sure about is the suspicion timing. Does it feel fair, or too forgiving?

Play it free in browser: [https://xorin.ai/made-with-xorin/shizu-no-kage](https://xorin.ai/made-with-xorin/shizu-no-kage)
